protocols.research_purpose: TAES reviewer revision: 22-field representation and cross-window evidence aggregation
protocols.label_policy: retain supplied episode labels, including quiet/unobserved attack windows
protocols.audit_annotation_policy: provenance only; never features, filtering, relabeling or model selection
protocols.selection: val macro_f1; equal within 1e-12 -> lower val loss
protocols.stop: encoder meaningful-F1 plateau; TST existing strict best metric patience
limitations: 22-field representation and cross-window evidence aggregation are the revision focus
prespecified finite training rules/maxima; full convergence or equal realized compute is not claimed
model families differ in capacity and compute; encoder results at L10 are conditional on this TST control
encoder seed varies initialization where applicable and training dropout; pretrained starting weights are identical
fixed window/TST head and shuffle seeds; no crossing with the separate ten-head-seed study
random/pretrained share tokenizer/architecture/training rules; initialization weights are the intended contrast
window-common and L10 share endpoints, but head capacity/training also differ
validation selects checkpoints; held-out test evaluation and uncertainty are a later step
all eligible shared-nominal windows/endpoints are retained, including quiet or unobserved attack windows
audit annotations remain provenance/diagnostics and never select training rows, labels or checkpoints
overall F1 alone does not demonstrate attack-evidence use or rule out generator signatures; interpret with benchmark/evidence audits

statistics_plan.primary_population: all eligible L10 endpoints with supplied episode labels, including quiet attack windows; no evidence-based exclusion or relabeling
statistics_plan.observability_interpretation: counterfactual annotations are diagnostic only; aggregate scores do not establish attack-evidence use or an information-theoretic ceiling
statistics_plan.test_count_source: authenticated Step 7 manifest/episode inventory; no test windows opened; evaluator must independently verify
statistics_plan.point_estimate: arithmetic mean of per-seed macro-F1; no probability ensemble
statistics_plan.seed_variation: sample SD across five encoder-training seeds
statistics_plan.primary_contrast_scope: encoder comparisons at L10 conditional on the same TST architecture/training recipe
statistics_plan.bootstrap_unit: class-stratified whole eligible episode, paired across all models and seeds
secondary_within_encoder_temporal_contra: CategoricalEmbedding_MLP: L10 TST minus window classifier at common L10 endpoints
FieldToken_Encoder: L10 TST minus window classifier at common L10 endpoints
DistilBERT_RandomInit_Train: L10 TST minus window classifier at common L10 endpoints
DistilBERT_Pretrained_Finetune: L10 TST minus window classifier at common L10 endpoints
statistics_plan.multiplicity_scope: three primary encoder contrasts and four explicitly secondary within-encoder contrasts are separate families; no joint seven-contrast coverage claim
statistics_plan.temporal_interpretation: same endpoint population, but differing head capacity/training; use pooling/LSTM controls for aggregator interpretation
statistics_plan.uncertainty_scope: episode CI conditional on the trained seeds; report encoder-seed SD separately; fixed TST seed
